question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
WITH customer_first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.first_payment_date,
        cl.total_ltv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pp.payment_date <= p.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '604800' SECOND THEN pp.amount ELSE 0 END) as amount_7days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pp.payment_date <= p.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '2592000' SECOND THEN pp.amount ELSE 0 END) as amount_30days
    FROM customer_first_payment p
    JOIN customer_ltv cl ON p.customer_id = cl.customer_id
    JOIN payment pp ON p.customer_id = pp.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, p.first_payment_date, cl.total_ltv
)
SELECT customer_id, first_payment_date, total_ltv, amount_7days, amount_30days
FROM customer_periods
LIMIT 5;

1. Gets each customer's first payment date

3. Gets sum of payments in first 7 days and first 30 days

<tool_call>
<function=run_sql_query>
<parameter=sql>
WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) AS first_payment_date,
        SUM(amount) AS total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.customer_id,
        cs.first_payment_date,
        cs.total_ltv,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date > cs.first_payment_date 
                         AND p.payment_date <= cs.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '7 days' 
                         AND p.amount > 0 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS first_7_days_sales,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date > cs.first_payment_date 
                         AND p.payment_date <= cs.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '30 days' 
                         AND p.amount > 0 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS first_30_days_sales
    FROM customer_stats cs
    LEFT JOIN payment p ON cs.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY cs.customer_id, cs.first_payment_date, cs.total_ltv
)
SELECT 
    AVG(100.0 * first_7_days_sales / total_ltv) AS avg_pct_7_days,
    AVG(100.0 * first_30_days_sales / total_ltv) AS avg_pct_30_days,
    AVG(total_ltv) AS avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_periods
WHERE total_ltv > 0
</parameter>
